rationale: Single source of truth for AWA operator-facing copy (plan v2.1 §H1). Until then, use the honest phrasing in `strings` below.

strings.text: AWA keeps your main folder pristine for shell commands and detects native file edits there; recovery bundles and patches protect work before destructive cleanup.
Automatic (shell-gated) — mutating commands enter a Safe Workspace before local changes land; native edits to main are detected, not pre-blocked.
I keep git/install commands out of your main folder before local changes land, and I flag native file edits.
Committed work stays on a branch; I save recovery bundles before cleanup and patches when you edit main natively — nothing gets lost.
Your main folder is protected against shell mutations; native file edits are detected and recoverable.
Engine off — your main folder is still protected for shell commands; native edits are detected.
